FN-FM7HCD5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 155
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/15/2024
Senate Bill 155 as introduced would require: (1) the Department of Revenue, rather than the
Department of Transportation, to report annually to the Joint Transportation Committee both the
local motor fuel excise tax revenues collected and the expenditures on road and bridge
maintenance and improvement for the immediately preceding fiscal year; and (2) the
Department of Examiners of Public Accounts, upon request of the Committee, to meet the
current reporting requirements regarding the performance of the Department of Transportation
on highway construction, maintenance, and costs for the immediately preceding fiscal year. This
bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1
